sql:
SELECT cls, COUNT(*) as trips, 
  ROUND(AVG(yt::float / (anglers + 1)), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(MAX(yt::float / (anglers + 1)), 3) as max_yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 2
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY avg_yt_per_angler DESC;
